test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He __consolidated__ his position as the leader of the political party.
solution: The correct answer s __**Weakened.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** __ • **Consolidate (verb)**- When you **consolidate** something, such as power or success, you strengthen it, making it more effective or secure. (दृढ़ करना, मजबूत बनाना, संगठित करना) • • *Example- With this new agenda, he has **consolidated** his position as the country's leading politician*. • Here, the opposite meaning of **consolidated** is **weakened**. • **Weaken *(verb)***- make or become weaker in power, resolve, or physical strength. (निर्बल करना,शिथिल होना, कमजोर होना या बनना)** ** • *Example - Fault lines had **weakened **and shattered the rocks.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Devised**- **Devise (Verb)** means to invent something new or a new way of doing something. (ईजाद करना, आविष्कार करना) • *Example- A new system has been **devised** by the company for the benefit of the employees.* • **Strengthened**- ** ****Strengthen (Verb)** means to become stronger, or to make something or somebody stronger. (मजबूत करना,शक्तिशाली बनना,दृढ़ करना) • • *Example- Repairs are necessary to **strengthen** the overbridge*. • **Formulated**- **Formulate (Verb)** means to create or prepare something carefully or give particular attention to the details.(निरूपित करना,सुविन्यस्त करना,प्रतिपादित करना) • • *Example- The new floor cleaner is **formulated** especially for wooden floors.* 19a:Ta17, The correct answer is "**DABC**".
